plugins.name: token-watch
plugins.description: Plan usage (5-hour, weekly and any model window), the context window and the prompt cache's countdown as thin bars above the prompt. Right-click to cycle its views; click the timer to keep the cache warm; /context-bar to hide, or to read it as text where nothing draws.
